title: Per-step routing decision and model continuity: resolver, lifecycle successors and a reasoning replay envelope

Grep -i replay (Model Plane code): thread and run event replay only; no reasoning replay

Grep Gemini|gemini (inference-core src): 0 hits; no Gemini adapter
Read proto execution.proto:92 and sessions.proto:1002: no thread or step model field
Doc grep RoutingDecision|ReplayEnvelope|signature_delta|successor|model_switched|router feedback (Model Plane docs, repo *.md): planning docs only
